# Codex App Server schema, codex-cli 0.170.0

Generated by the installed binary with

    CODEX_HOME=<empty dir> codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <dir>

on 2026-11-19 (macOS, aarch64-apple-darwin). Only the files the KAIORX adapter uses are kept.
SHA-256 over all 329 generated files (sorted, concatenated): `22b6df4324c33a4945cab3ba72870108aca2745fe617552ccb85e46966091bf0`.

The contract tests validate every request the adapter sends and every message of the fixture
server against these files. A new Codex version needs a newly generated schema and a passing
contract test before it enters the compatibility matrix.
